content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has a huge selection of ad-free, no in-app purchases games.

Apple Arcade is a subscription plan suitable for the whole family, but it's not the only option. If you're a Netflix subscriber, your monthly fee already includes a wide range of excellent iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription includes a massive library of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription plan now includes a large selection of mobile and TV games.

This includes the most affordable plan, the "Standard with Ads" tier at $8.99 per month.

Regardless of which Netflix membership you use, you can enjoy mobile and TV games for free, with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

For TV games, Netflix provides a dedicated iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into a game controller, working with supported Netflix smart TV apps to play games. If you want to further enhance your mobile gaming experience, pairing a dedicated iPhone gamepad is an even better choice.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app designed specifically for kids, called Netflix Playground, which contains multiple mini-games. There are also Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond the above titles, Netflix offers over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store and then log in with your Netflix email and password to play.
